title: Return of the Crimson Guard
author: Esslemont, Ian C.
review:
This book is a hot mess but I had fun with it for the most part. Showcases a lot of the best and worst of Malazan, definitely confusing as hell and way too many story lines with fast POV changes and too many hidden identities and written in a way where it actively hides information from you. This book is like drinking from a fire hose and can be a bit much at times.

However there's a lot of cool stuff in it and it being complementary to the main series was really nice, it fleshes out some world building only touched on in the main series and continues some plot points with much needed resolutions.
